links.outcome: AI processing rate and referral accuracy in real-world optometry settings
links.effect: Octane processed images from only 204 of 396 participants (51.5%); could not process 48.5%; generalisability challenges in real-world evaluation.
links.quote: The artificial intelligence model presented challenges relating to its generalisability in a real-world evaluation context.

links.outcome: AI referral decision accuracy versus hospital experts and community optometrists
links.effect: Octane showed inferior sensitivity and specificity versus human expert assessors (clinical reference standard); similar accuracy to community optometrists.
links.quote: Compared to hospital-based experts for referral decisions, Octane was less accurate at making routine and urgent referral decisions and of similar accuracy to community optometrists.
